notes.cpu_ratios: Variant/reference elapsed time; smaller than one is faster. Medians are recomputed from recorded trials.
notes.paired_ratios: Match sequential rotated trials by repetition within a run. Ranges are observed extrema, not confidence intervals.
notes.equivalence: Every variant in a run must have identical endpoint digests and per-depth tree statistics. Runs with different cutoffs or sinks are never pooled.
notes.scope: CPU benchmark only. Preserve each config for table size, table construction time, sink behavior and excluded costs. No GPU is timed.

config.packing: packed sink stores four u32 words per endpoint by F, shared-family flag, black_box flushes every 4096 endpoints; no queue or device
config.root_selection: Uniform baseline K38 roots rejected by improved13 ancestry and checkpoint walkback; same roots and pruning policy in every variant
